name: Kira Bloom
title: Petal Cut
description: A florist who turned clippers into a fighting style. Pretty until the second hit lands.
source_description: Female fighter, compact, pink hair, green wrap dress, playful personality, wind-based powers.
special_desc: A two-hit crescent that keeps you guessing high or late.
ultimate_desc: Explodes a ring of petals at her feet.
